## Highlights
### Fixed
- A mouse's Back and Forward buttons move one page per click, every time, including on pages that run in Chromium. - Swiping back and forward works on pages that run in Chromium, including a mouse's Back and Forward actions set up in Logitech Options+ and three-finger swipes between pages.
---
